svg.title: Central Coast (CA) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Central Coast; 2: Monterey; 3: Santa Cruz; 4: King City; 5: Santa Maria; 6: Santa Barbara; 7: Lompoc; 8: Los Olivos; 9: Brookdale; 10: Day Valley; 11: Livermore Valley; 12: San Luis Obispo

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
